description: Validation test suite for React Rendering and Performance Technology Skill rule detection and safe counterpart patterns.

testCases.description: Verify detection of nested component declaration inside parent render body destroying component identity and causing remounts.

expected.notes: Nested component function declared inside parent function body recreated on every render.
Child component is extracted to top-level module scope, preserving component identity.

testCases.description: Verify detection of unmemoized object literal passed into Context Provider value triggering re-render cascades.

expected.notes: AuthContext.Provider receives newly allocated object literal on every render of AuthProvider.
Context value object is memoized using useMemo with [user] dependency.

testCases.description: Verify detection of CPU-heavy data transformations executed synchronously on every render without useMemo.

expected.notes: heavyDataProcessing is executed synchronously on every render including unrelated toggle state changes.
Calculation is cached with useMemo, recalculating only when items or threshold change.

testCases.description: Verify detection of React.memo optimization defeated by passing newly allocated inline callback from parent.

expected.notes: Inline arrow function passed to React.memo child component breaks shallow prop equality on every parent render.
Callback is wrapped in useCallback, maintaining stable reference across renders.

testCases.description: Verify detection of blocking urgent input updates with heavy non-urgent list filtering in React 18+.

expected.notes: Heavy array filter runs synchronously alongside urgent query state update without startTransition.
Heavy filtering is wrapped in startTransition, keeping text input responsive.
